columns.run_id: Identifier for a model run, including date or git hash when possible.
columns.predicted_efficiency: Predicted total editing efficiency, 0-1 if calibrated.
columns.predicted_outcome: Predicted edited sequence or outcome label.
columns.predicted_score: Raw uncalibrated score or model-specific score.
columns.model_editor: Editor setting passed to the model.
columns.model_cell_context: Cell/context setting passed to the model.
columns.raw_output_path: Path to raw model output captured for audit.
columns.model_version: Git commit, release, web access date, or local status.
